findings.explanation: Intellectual property ownership assigns to the client immediately upon creation rather than waiting for full payment.
findings.suggested_change: Upon receipt of full payment for the applicable services, the Contractor hereby assigns to the Client all right, title, and interest in the deliverables.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hi, I hope you are doing well. I am looking forward to getting started, but I would like to request a few adjustments to the agreement before I sign it. - Regarding the relevant clause concerning intellectual property ownership, the agreement currently assigns ownership immediately upon creation rather than waiting for full payment. I propose changing this so that the rights transfer upon receipt of full payment for the applicable services. Thank you for understanding, and I look forward to finalizing this soon. Best regards,
